1.title: Liberia Agrees to Take 1,200 Deportees From U.S.
1.summary: The arrangement is one of the largest known deals that the Trump administration has struck to expel migrants who cannot be sent back to their home countries.

2.title: Trump Officials Ignored Their Own University Investigations, Lawyer Says
2.summary: A former Justice Department lawyer says Trump administration leaders ignored findings that elite schools, including Brown and Columbia, hadn’t broken the law as they pressed them into deals.

3.title: University of Michigan Names President After Prior Pick Faced Brain Cancer
3.summary: The university chose a Vanderbilt academic, Cybele Raver, after a previous candidate for the role had to step down because of a brain cancer diagnosis.

4.title: Israel Strikes Air Base in Syria, Drawing Ire From the U.S.
4.summary: The attack was the latest in a series of Israeli military interventions in Syria over the past two years.

5.title: A Mother’s Quest to Rescue Her Son From Russian-Occupied Ukraine
5.summary: They made a risky bid to reunite after three years of separation, illness and deprivation — the kind of ordeal suffered by many thousands of families torn apart by the war in eastern Ukraine.

6.title: Disney and ABC sue Trump's media regulator to stop early licence renewal
6.summary: The network accuses the administration of retaliating against ABC because it "disapproves of what ABC broadcasts".
